h1: The 5 Best Eureka Cordless Vacuums of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Eureka Cordless Vacuums: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: five Eureka cordless stick vacuums compared on runtime, wattage and tangle or pet-hair features, so you pick the right model.
summary: The Eureka ReactiSense 350W is our top pick for its 60-minute runtime and higher wattage. The ReactiClean 200W suits smaller homes that want 50 minutes. The RapidClean Pro Pet Hair is the one to pick if shedding is the daily problem, and the Tangle-Free 250W is the all-rounder for mixed floors.
intro: Eureka's cordless lineup looks confusing because the names change by a word or two while the spec sheets look alike. Most buyers end up comparing a runtime figure and a wattage figure and guessing the rest. The smarter way is to work out which problem you are solving: long runtime, hair tangles, or a small footprint.

We reviewed five Eureka cordless stick vacuums and ranked them on the spec sheet: listed runtime, wattage where given, and the tangle and pet-hair features named in each title. Other brands in the original comparison were dropped because this guide is about Eureka only.

products.name: Eureka ReactiSense 350W Anti-Tangle Cordless Stick Vacuum
products.verdict: The longest listed runtime and highest wattage in the Eureka lineup.
products.description:
The ReactiSense is listed at 350W and 60 minutes of runtime, and it carries an anti-tangle design. Those are the strongest numbers among the Eureka models here.

It ranks above the ReactiClean 200W because it adds both more power and ten more minutes on the clock. The tradeoff is that the spec sheet gives no weight, so a bigger motor may come with a heavier feel.

Best for homes with long hair or a large floor area where one charge needs to go far. Check the weight on the live listing before buying if you plan to carry it upstairs.
products.idealFor: Larger homes with long hair to pick up.
products.skipIf: You want the lightest possible vacuum.

products.name: Eureka ReactiClean 200W Lightweight Cordless Stick Vacuum
products.verdict: A lightweight 200W stick with 50 minutes of listed runtime.
products.description:
The ReactiClean is a lightweight cordless stick rated at 200W with 50 minutes of runtime. It is the model positioned for smaller footprints.

It trails the ReactiSense because it gives up 150W and ten minutes of runtime. In return you get the lightweight positioning, which matters in an apartment.

Pick it for a studio or small home where 50 minutes covers a full clean. Skip it if your floors are large or you need heavy-duty suction.
products.skipIf: You have a large house to clean.

products.name: Eureka RapidClean Pro 250W Tangle-Free Cordless Stick Vacuum
products.verdict: A 250W tangle-free stick with 40 minutes of listed runtime.
products.description:
The RapidClean Pro 250W is a tangle-free cordless stick listed at 250W and 40 minutes of runtime.

It sits third because its runtime is ten minutes shorter than the ReactiClean above, even though its wattage is higher. If you value power per charge over duration, it comes out ahead.

Best for mixed floors in a mid-size home where 40 minutes is enough. The caveat is that runtime is the shortest tier among these Eurekas.
products.skipIf: You need an hour of cleaning per charge.

products.name: Eureka RapidClean Pro Pet Hair Cordless Vacuum
products.verdict: The Eureka aimed at shedding pets, with 40 minutes of listed runtime.
products.description:
The RapidClean Pro Pet Hair is a cordless vacuum aimed at pet owners, listed at 40 minutes of runtime. No wattage is given on the listing.

It ranks fourth because the spec sheet is thinner than the 250W Tangle-Free model above. What you are paying for is the pet-hair focus, not a stronger motor on paper.

Best for homes with a shedding dog or cat. Verify the brush and bin details on the live listing, since they are not in our data.
products.idealFor: Homes with a shedding dog or cat.
products.skipIf: You have no pets and want more runtime.

products.name: Eureka RapidClean Pro Lightweight Cordless Stick Vacuum
products.verdict: A lightweight stick with 40 minutes of listed runtime and little else on the sheet.
products.description:
The RapidClean Pro Lightweight is a cordless stick listed at 40 minutes of runtime, with no wattage given.

It finishes last because the listing offers the fewest differentiators: no tangle or pet claim in the title and no power figure. Against the 250W Tangle-Free sibling, you have less to go on.

Best for light daily upkeep in a small home. Check the live listing for weight and power before choosing it over its siblings.
products.idealFor: Light daily upkeep in small homes.
products.skipIf: You want a stated power rating.

whatMatters.detail: Runtime is how long the battery lasts before the vacuum stops, and it is usually quoted on the lowest power setting. A 60-minute figure is plenty for a large floor, while 40 minutes covers a small home. Look for the minute figure in the bullets and assume stronger modes drain faster.

Wattage describes motor input, not cleaning performance, but within one brand it is a reasonable shorthand for strength. The 350W ReactiSense is the strongest on paper here. Check whether the listing states a number at all, since several models do not.

Hair wraps around brush rolls and slows cleaning, so tangle-free designs matter for long hair. Titles like Anti-Tangle and Tangle-Free signal the feature. Read the listing for how the brush works before assuming it suits you.
Pet-labeled models are tuned for shedding fur. That helps most if you vacuum daily. Confirm bin size and brush details on the live listing, since a name alone does not prove them.
A lighter stick is easier on stairs and in tight rooms. Weight is not in our data for these models, so look it up on the listing before you buy.

cards.text: Higher wattage suits mixed floors. Picks: Eureka ReactiSense 350W and RapidClean Pro 250W.

howToChoose.note: Most buyers should default to the ReactiSense, which leads on both.

cards.text: A lightweight stick with enough runtime to finish a small space in one go.

faq.q: Are all of these cordless sticks?
faq.a: Yes, all five are listed as cordless. Check the listing for whether the stick converts to handheld, since our data does not say.

faq.q: What is the most common mistake buying a Eureka?
faq.a: Assuming similar names mean similar specs. The RapidClean Pro versions share a 40-minute runtime but differ in features, so read each title.

faq.q: Is the ReactiSense worth it over the ReactiClean?
faq.a: If you need the extra ten minutes and 150W on paper, yes. For a small home the ReactiClean is enough.
Follow the manual, but in general charge fully before first use and keep the battery away from heat. Our data does not give charge time.
Empty the bin and clear hair from the brush roll regularly. Tangle-free designs reduce this, but do not remove it.

faq.q: Is the pet hair model only for pet owners?
faq.a: No, but its value is the pet focus. Without pets, the 250W Tangle-Free or ReactiSense offers more listed specs.

finalTake: The Eureka ReactiSense 350W is the best of the group on paper, with 60 minutes and 350W. The ReactiClean 200W is the right call for small homes, and the RapidClean Pro Pet Hair is the specialist. Confirm weight on the live listing before buying, since it is the spec most missing here.
